summary: The trace shows a critical failure pattern: custom statistical implementations produced wildly incorrect p-values (e.g., 1.99, 2.0, 0.98 when correct values were 0.006, 0.0, 0.022). The agent caught this by inspecting outputs and switched to scipy.stats. This skill captures the lesson: always use scipy.stats for statistical tests and validate p-values are in [0,1] range.
